title: Key doctor checks for refused remote deliveries by root and record
outcome: Doctor and projection repair avoid rescanning all root feed entries for each refused remote verification association.
acceptance: The refused-association root membership check uses a keyed lookup or the integrity pass's existing occurrence map, so unrelated root-feed growth adds no repeated scan per refused record
Doctor still detects extra run membership, wrong-root membership, and root entries for unknown or foreign destinations; historical project-only refusals retain their forward-only interpretation
A deterministic query-work or plan regression covers the bounded lookup without wall-clock timing
